def stat(d):
    m = np.asarray(d['body_mass'], dtype=float)
    g = np.asarray(d['treated'], dtype=bool)
    a = m[g]
    b = m[~g]
    sp = np.sqrt(((len(a) - 1) * np.var(a, ddof=1) + (len(b) - 1) * np.var(b, ddof=1)) / (len(a) + len(b) - 2))
    return float(abs(np.mean(a) - np.mean(b)) / sp)

def stat(d):
    x = np.asarray(d['systolic_bp'], dtype=float)
    m = x.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(m, dtype=float)
    tc = t - t.mean()
    b = (x - x.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) @ tc / np.sum(tc ** 2)
    fit = x.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) + b[:, None] * tc[None, :]
    s2 = np.mean(np.sum((x - fit) ** 2, axis=1) / (m - 2))
    return float(s2 / np.var(x[:, 0], ddof=1))
